earnings.title: IQVIA Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Revenue $4,428 million, up 8.0% year-over-year, up 8.6% at constant currency
GAAP Net Income $350 million, Adjusted EBITDA $1,032 million, up 8.7% year-over-year
GAAP Diluted Earnings per Share $2.10, Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share $3.34, up 11.3% year-over-year
Commercial Solutions Revenue $1,789 million, up 6.9% year-over-year, up 7.9% at constant currency
R&D Solutions Revenue $2,639 million, up 8.7% year-over-year, up 9.1% at constant currency

quotes.text: IQVIA delivered another record quarter, with revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Diluted EPS all exceeding the high end of our expectations.
quotes.by: Ari Bousbib, chairman and CEO of IQVIA

outlook: The company expects approximately $9.4 billion of this backlog to convert to revenue in the next twelve months, representing growth of 10% year-over-year.

The company is raising its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue to be between $17,350 million and $17,500 million, for Adjusted EBITDA to be between $4,025 million and $4,055 million and for Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share to be between $12.90 and $13.00.

items.heading: The potential loss or delay of our large contracts or of multiple contracts could adversely affect our results.

We depend on third parties for data and support services. Our suppliers or providers might restrict our use of or refuse to license data or provide services, which could lead to our inability to access certain data or provide certain services and, as a result, materially and adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.

If we fail to perform our services in accordance with contractual requirements, regulatory standards and ethical considerations, we could be subject to significant costs or liability and our reputation could be harmed.

Security breaches and unauthorized use of our IT systems and information, or the IT systems or information in the possession of our vendors, could expose us, our clients, our data suppliers or others to risk of loss.
items.group: Failure of vendors to perform contractual obligations
